purpose: Define managed UI localization as explicit label identities plus context metadata and translations, while commands and internal identifiers remain English-only canonical semantics.

topics.name: Localization
topics.purpose: Define managed UI localization as explicit label identities plus context metadata and translations, while commands and internal identifiers remain English-only canonical semantics.

semantics.label_rule: UI labels are extracted into managed identities with context metadata.
semantics.command_rule: Commands/internal identifiers remain English-only and avoid special characters.
semantics.translation_rule: Translations alter presentation text only, not canonical semantic identity.
semantics.context_rule: Label context metadata is retained so identical source strings in different semantic contexts may translate differently.
semantics.fallback_rule: Missing translation uses explicit fallback policy; it does not invent semantic meaning.
semantics.projection_rule: Localization is an Expose projection concern and does not alter domain/runtime semantics.

invariants.rule: Editor subtools are projections/operation surfaces over canonical semantics and do not become independent authorities.

hard_gates.condition: translated label changes canonical command/internal identifier
same textual label assumed same semantic identity without context
missing translation silently invents new domain semantics
UI language determines runtime capability or authority
special localized characters introduced into canonical command identifiers

prose.summary: Define managed UI localization as explicit label identities plus context metadata and translations, while commands and internal identifiers remain English-only canonical semantics.
